description:
Closes fz-kdt.34's acceptance contract on `enum_take_drop_split`,
`fz_f98_range_map_converges` and `enum_predicate_search`, using ONLY the public
log.

## The derivation -- causality is derived, not stored

The scheduler records WHICH facts a job read but never at what revision
(`DependencyIndex.reads`), and the product engine is the opposite. So 'did this
formula's input move since its own prior conclusion?' cannot be answered by
asking the scheduler without adding a second dependency ledger, which this
ticket forbids.

It IS answerable by replaying the ordered stream. For evaluation e of formula F
at time t, the moved inputs are exactly

    (F's reads UNION F's blocked-set from its previous completion)
      for which a movement appears in the stream between F's previous
      conclusion and t

Reads alone are NOT enough: `reads` and `waits` are separate maps, and a job
re-run because a WAIT became satisfiable has that fact in `waits`. Using reads
alone false-flags it as uncaused. Everything needed is already on the stream:
`work_graph.applied` carries job identity, changed (old/new revision + old/new
settled -- the content-vs-readiness split), wakes (cause FactUse: Current =
content, Settled/SettledPresence = readiness; disposition; shift), movements
(post-state), blocked, and semantic.reads.

## Cross-run equality: the stream must be SELF-DESCRIBING

Cross-run equality must hold CROSS-PROCESS, where raw ids drift (fz-kdt.47: 16
arena slots differ across processes) and the World that could translate them is
gone. So the jsonl projection emits DEFINITION-ON-FIRST-USE lines: the first
time the sink renders a given raw `arrow` it emits
`canon.arrow {arrow: N, canon: <fz-f98.21 canonical form>}` first (same for
`function_id` -> label), then the referencing event. All inside the handler
where &World is in hand; memoized so the cost is per DISTINCT id; zero
production emit sites change; telemetry-off renders nothing. Every log is then
self-contained: join raw -> canonical per run and compare causal multisets
across processes or versions. Types::display must NOT be used (measured
non-injective); the canonical form is the comparand.

## Deliverables

1. `telemetry::causal` -- pub replay module at the sink/test boundary (usable
   by tests/fz2_cli.rs and a future trace-diff tool): parse a public stream,
   join the canon tables, derive the causal report (per formula identity:
   evaluations classified initial/content-caused/readiness-caused, changed vs
   unchanged outputs, wakes, blocked; per product identity: settlements,
   generations, changed split, cache hits, displacements).
2. Acceptance test in public_trace_test.rs over the three fixtures: every
   non-initial evaluation names a moved dependency (red-first: the reads-only
   variant false-flags wait-satisfied jobs); readiness-only causes classified
   separately, never claimed as content; no content-cause without a real
   revision move; unsanctioned_work_starts == 0 and root_scans == 0 read from
   pull.session.finished. Work counts, never wall-clock; no absolute-count pins
   beyond the zeros.
3. Cross-process equality in fz2_cli.rs: run a fixture twice as separate
   processes with --log-telemetry, derive both causal reports through the canon
   join, assert identical multisets -- raw ids may drift; canonical identity
   must not.
4. Docs: telemetry.md + performance-instrumentation.md gain the causal fields
   and the self-describing-stream contract; DELETE the guidance telling
   investigators to infer identity or causality from counts.

## Baseline at HEAD (efa05d386, enum_take_drop_split, debug interp, 2026-08-28)

    21,437 public events; 2,593 job spans; 2,595 work_graph.applied
    12,645 pull.product.settled over 12,523 DISTINCT product keys (max 6 per
    key -- volume not churn, dominated by incoming_input_slot); 576 cache_hit;
    399 displaced; 8 demand.cone.settled; 3 pull.session.finished each carrying
    the full work-start tally incl. unsanctioned_work_starts and root_scans.

The fz2_cli budget pins (fz-kdt.52) may need one modest, attributed bump for the
canon definition lines -- measure, do not guess.
